user.title: Dish Aligner setup
user.description: Pick the two devices that make up the dish. **Rotator**: the ESPHome device driving the stepper. **Radio**: the OpenWrt device (NanoBeam) mounted on it.

packages.title: Radio dependencies
packages.description:
Dish Aligner needs these on the radio:

{status}

**Missing:** {missing}

Install on the radio (SSH or Luci → System → Software):
- `iwinfo` → `apk add iwinfo` (signal + survey scans)
- `iw` → `apk add iw` (hidden-SSID probes)
- `rpcd ACL` → copy `openwrt/homeassistant.json` from this repo to `/usr/share/rpcd/acl.d/` then `service rpcd reload`

`librespeed-cli` is optional: `apk add librespeed-cli-rust` is the small build for radios with limited flash (like the NanoBeam); `apk add librespeed-go` works too. Either gives the post-align test full ping/jitter/upload results - without it, a simple download test is used.

Use **Re-check** after installing.

radio.title: Wireless interface
radio.description: The radio reports {iface_count} wireless interface(s). Pick the one the dish uses for its uplink - that's the interface surveys will scan on.

verify.title: Verification

abort.missing_openwrt: The OpenWrt integration (FaserF/ha-openwrt) isn't installed or isn't loaded. Set it up for your radio first.
abort.missing_esphome: No loaded ESPHome device was found. Flash the rotator firmware and adopt it first.
abort.missing_entities: One or more required entities couldn't be found on the chosen devices. Check the rotator is running the dish-aligner firmware (azimuth_target number, azimuth_moving sensor) and the radio exposes signal sensors.

data.excluded_aps: APs to hide (comma-separated SSIDs or BSSIDs)
data.builtin_speedtest: Test on the radio after auto-align (uses librespeed-cli if installed, else a ~15s download)
data.verify_service: Speed-test service to call (e.g. speedtestdotnet.speedtest) - overrides the trigger entity
data.speedtest_sensor: Download-speed sensor to read the test result from (e.g. sensor.speedtest_download)
